title: A Canonical Data Transformation for Achieving Inter- and Within-group Fairness
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and statistical definitions of algorithmic fairness (specifically demographic parity and a new 'within-group' fairness) and proposes a data transformation framework. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith traditions, or qualitative ethical/moral systems, but rather treats fairness as a mathematical constraint in classification tasks using tabular data.
